title: First variation of the rescaling V_{x,t}: change of variables for the divergence integral
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^N, let V be an n-varifold on U (V : Varifold N n U; no bounded-first-variation, support or integrability hypothesis is needed), x ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0, and X : ℝ^N → ℝ^N a C¹ vector field. Put ψ(z) := t⁻¹(z − x) and Y(z) := t·X(ψ(z)). Then ∫ div_S X(y) dV_{x,t}(y,S) = (t⁻¹)^n·δV(Y), where V_{x,t} = rescaledMeasure V x t = ofReal((t⁻¹)^n)·(V.measure).map((z,S) ↦ (ψ z, S)), div_S X(y) = Varifold.tangentialDivergence X y S = trace(S·jacobian X y), and δV(Y) = V.firstVariation Y = ∫ div_S Y(z) dV(z,S) (all integrals are Bochner integrals; the identity holds as such).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N), 0 < t → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z.1 z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x t) = t⁻¹ ^ n * V.firstVariation (fun z : Euclidean N ↦ t • X (t⁻¹ • (z - x)))
